points.text: Meghan Markle said allegations that her estranged father possessed child abuse images deeply distressed her and that she had heard similar accusations in 2018.
Two former FBI officials were charged with making false statements to Congress about their roles in the bureau’s Hunter Biden laptop investigation.
The Justice Department filed a lawsuit seeking to block certification of Alaska’s Senate results if incumbent Dan Sullivan loses, citing confusion between candidates with the same surname.
Gunmen killed seven people and wounded about 40 during a funeral at a church in Jordan; authorities are searching for the suspects.
A building under construction collapsed in Nairobi’s Eastleigh area, prompting fears people were trapped as rescue operations began.
